title: Bitcoin UX Principles
description: The Bitcoin Design Guide becomes our spine, usability heuristics meet real wallet flows, and the Weeks 3–5 Flow Redesign project is issued.

objectives: Navigate the Bitcoin Design Guide's design-process hub: usage life cycle, personal finance framing, reference designs
Apply the Units & Symbols chapter — BTC vs sats vs ₿, formatting rules, conversion display
Map NN/g's 10 usability heuristics to real Bitcoin examples
Choose your Flow Redesign flow and run a principle-based competitive scan of three wallets

resources.title: Bitcoin Design Guide — "Designing bitcoin products" (introduction)
resources.desc: CORE. The Guide's design-process hub: usage life cycle, personal finance framing, and how the reference designs are meant to be used. This chapter makes the rest of the Guide navigable. From this week on, the Guide is our spine.

resources.title: Bitcoin Design Guide — "Units & symbols"
resources.desc: CORE. BTC vs sats vs ₿, formatting rules, conversion display: the reference for this week's hardest segment and a chapter you'll keep open for the rest of your career.

resources.title: Bitcoin Design Guide — "First use" (Daily Spending Wallet reference design)
resources.desc: CORE for Option A designers / recommended for everyone. The Guide's full worked reference for first-time experience in a lightning-first, self-custodial wallet, from app store listing to funded wallet.

resources.title: NN/g — "10 Usability Heuristics for User Interface Design"
resources.desc: CORE. The classic. Refresh it now: our audit rubric in Lesson 6 is built from these plus the Design Guide, and this week's call maps each heuristic to a Bitcoin example.

resources.title: Bitcoin Design Community — Design Review call recordings
resources.desc: VIDEO. Watch one recent Design Review call (~60 min, or 30 min at 2×): working Bitcoin designers critiquing real product flows in public. Watch for how they critique: principle cited, screen named, alternative proposed. That's the format your Gate 2 crit uses. Facilitator curates 1–2 current picks each cohort in #week-3.
